paragraphs: He reports Resh Lakish. He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 117a, and Rashi explains there that he was a sage, a student of Resh Lakish.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The opening אר״ל connects the headword’s report to Resh Lakish; it is not a detached quotation. The William Davidson digital text of Bava Metzia 117a writes וסטיני with an additional yod in parentheses. The Vilna digital text of Rashi identifies him as a sage and student of Resh Lakish. That student identification is commentary, distinct from the Gemara’s transmission formula; Hyman’s headword Satina is retained.
